statement.text: Delta-conjecture (1978): consider a complete graph $(V;E_{1},\dots ,E_{d})$ each edge of which is colored by one of $d$ colors such that there exists a triangle $\Delta $ colored in three pairwise distinct colors. Then, in each chromatic component $(V,E_{i}),i=1,\dots ,d$ , one can choose a maximal independent vertex-set such that the intersection of the obtained $d$ sets is empty.

title: Delta-conjecture (1978)
